entities.name: Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome
observations: Macrosomia, macroglossia, hemihyperplasia, ear creases, abdominal wall hernia, and visceromegaly are characteristic features; neonatal hyperinsulinism can cause hypoglycemia.

entities.name: Neonatal symptomatic hypoglycemia
observations: In a newborn with lethargy, poor feeding, tremors, and hypotonia, suspected symptomatic hypoglycemia requires prompt glucose treatment.
